decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - All new external finishes in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of the materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm Monday to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until the commence until final details for the control of odours and noise from the kitchen exhaust duct have been submitted to an approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 7 - The scheme approved under condition 6 shall be fully implemented before the restaurant opens to customers.
Condition : 8 - The lantern rooflight of the ground floor shall be fixed and un-openable at all times.
Condition : 9 - Pedestrian access in accordance with the approved plans is to be provided and maintained permanently to the residence above the premises.
Condition : 10 - The proposed brick cladding to the external duct shall be completed prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension on basement level and single storey rear extension on ground floor level incorporating new external staircase and installation of extract duct at roof level.
